description: The molecule is a ceramide that is the N-hexacosanoyl derivative of C20 phytosphingosine. It is a C20 phytoceramide and a N-(very-long-chain fatty acyl)-sphingoid base.

The molecule is a hydrochloride salt resulting from the reaction of equimolar amounts of gevotroline and hydrogen chloride. It has a role as an antipsychotic agent and a dopamine receptor D2 antagonist. It contains a gevotroline(1+).

The molecule is a steroid glucosiduronic acid that consists of 17beta-estradiol having a beta-glucuronyl residue attached at position 3 via a glycosidic linkage. It has a role as a human metabolite and a mouse metabolite. It is a 17beta-hydroxy steroid, a beta-D-glucosiduronic acid and a steroid glucosiduronic acid. It is a conjugate acid of a 17beta-estradiol 3-O-(beta-D-glucuronide)(1-).

The molecule is a hydroxy fatty acid ascaroside anion that is the conjugate base of oscr#10, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3. It is a conjugate base of an oscr#10.
The molecule is a haloalkane that is bromoethane substituted by chlorine at position 2. It has a role as a mutagen. It is a haloalkane, an organobromine compound and an organochlorine compound.

The molecule is an amino pentasaccharide in which an alpha-L-fucosyl-(1->2)-beta-D-galactosyl-(1->4)-N-acetyl-6-O-sulfo-D-glucosaminyl unit and a D-galactosyl residue are linked respectively beta(1->6) and beta(1->3) to an N-acetyl-D-galactosamine residue. It is an amino pentasaccharide sulfate and an amino pentasaccharide sulfate.

The molecule is a monocarboxylic acid anion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group of D-gluconate; major species at pH 7.3. It is a conjugate base of a D-gluconate. It is an enantiomer of a D-gluconate.

The molecule is a member of the class of cyclohexapeptides that is cyclohexapeptide substituted by a cyclohexapeptide. It has a role as a metabolite. It is a member of cyclohexapeptides and a member of cyclohexapeptides.
The molecule is a monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of methoxyacetic acid, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group. It is a conjugate base of a methoxyacetic acid.
The molecule is a D-alpha-L-galactose in which the carbon bearing the anomeric hydroxy group has alpha configuration. It is an enantiomer of an alpha-L-galactose.

The molecule is a C21-steroid hormone in which a pregnane skeleton carries oxo substituents at positions 3 and 20 and is unsaturated at C(4)-C(5). As a hormone, it is involved in the female menstrual cycle, pregnancy and embryogenesis of humans and other species. It has a role as a contraceptive drug, a progestin, a progesterone receptor agonist, a human metabolite and a mouse metabolite. It is a 20-oxo steroid, a 3-oxo-Delta(4) steroid and a C21-steroid.
The molecule is a dipeptide composed of L-serine and L-lysine joined by a peptide linkage. It has a role as a bacterial metabolite. It derives from a L-serine and a L-lysine.

The molecule is a phenolate anion that is the conjugate base of 2',4,4',6'-tetrahydroxychalcone, obtained by deprotonation of the phenolic hydroxy group at position 2'; major species at pH 7.3. It has a role as an anti-allergic agent, an anti-inflammatory agent and a metabolite. It is a phenolate anion, a 2',4,4',6'-tetrahydroxychalcone and a 2-acyl-4-prenylphloroglucinol(1-).

The molecule is a hydroxyicosapentaenoic acid that is the conjugate base of (5Z,8Z,10E,14Z)-12-hydroxyicosapentaenoic acid. It has a role as a human xenobiotic metabolite. It is a conjugate base of a (5Z,8Z,10E,14Z)-12-hydroxyicosapentaenoic acid.

The molecule is a diterpene lactone isolated from the whole plant of Ajuga ciliata. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is an acetate ester, a butenolide, a diterpene lactone, an enoate ester and a spiro-epoxide.
The molecule is a hydroxyether that is ethanol substituted by a methoxy group at position 2. It has a role as a protic solvent and a solvent.
The molecule is a hydrochloride salt obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group of chlorobenzene. It has a role as an antispasmodic drug. It contains a chlorobenzene(1+).
The molecule is a dicarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 2-methylideneglutarate(2-). It is a conjugate base of a 2-methylideneglutarate(2-).

The molecule is a 1-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-1D-myo-inositol in which the 1-acyl group is specified as linoleoyl. It derives from a linoleic acid. It is a conjugate acid of a 1-linoleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phospho-1D-myo-inositol.

The molecule is a diterpene lactone isolated from the whole plant of Ajuga ciliata. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is an acetate ester, a butenolide, a diterpene lactone, an enoate ester and a spiro-epoxide.

The molecule is an unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (13Z,14Z,16Z)-icosatrienoic acid. It is a long-chain fatty acyl-CoA and an unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA. It derives from a (13Z,14Z,16Z)-icosatrienoyl-CoA. It is a conjugate acid of a (13Z,14Z,16Z)-icosatrienoyl-CoA(4-).

The molecule is a carboxylic ester resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of (2S)-3-hydroxy-2-phenylpropanoic acid with the hydroxy group of (2R,4S,5S,7s)-9-butyl-7-hydroxy-9-methyl-3-oxa-9-azoniatricyclo[3.3.1.0(2,4)]nonane. It has a role as a muscarinic antagonist and an antispasmodic drug. It is a carboxylic ester, an epoxide, a quaternary ammonium ion and a tropane alkaloid.

The molecule is a quinoline ion obtained by protonation of the quinoline nitrogen and tertiary amino group of the antimalarial drug chloroquine. It is the major species at pH 7.3. It is a quinoline ion and a tertiary ammonium ion. It is a conjugate acid of a chloroquine.

The molecule is an amino disaccharide consisting of N-acetylneuaminic acid and D-galactopyranose joined by a (2->3) glycosidic bond. It is a member of neuraminic acids, a partially-defined glycan, an amino disaccharide, a member of acetamides and a monocarboxylic acid.
The molecule is a dipeptide that is the N-(L-alpha-aspartyl) derivative of L-leucine. It has a role as a human urinary metabolite. It derives from an aspartic acid and a leucine.

The molecule is a steroid saponin that is (5alpha,6alpha,22R,25S)-6,22,26-trihydroxyfurostan-3-one in which the hydroxy group at position 6 has been converted into the beta-D-glucopyranosyl-(1->3)-alpha-L-rhamnoside derivative, while that at position 26 has been converted to its beta-D-glucoside. It has a role as a metabolite and an antiviral agent. It is a steroid saponin, a disaccharide derivative, a pentacyclic triterpenoid and a 3-oxo-5alpha-steroid.
The molecule is the sodium salt of sulcofuron. It has a role as an epitope. It is an organic sodium salt and a member of ureas. It contains a sulcofuronate.

The molecule is a monocarboxylic acid that is the mono-(3,4-dichloroanilide) of malonic acid. It is a monocarboxylic acid, a dicarboxylic acid monoamide and a dichlorobenzene. It derives from a malonamic acid. It is a conjugate acid of a N-(3,4-dichlorophenyl)malonamate.

The molecule is a glutamyl-L-amino acid obtained by formal condensation of the gamma-carboxy group of glutamic acid with the amino group of leucine. It has a role as a human metabolite. It derives from a glutamic acid and a leucine. It is a conjugate acid of a gamma-Glu-Leu(1-).

The molecule is a 2-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine in which the acyl group is specified as octadecanoyl (stearoyl). It is a lysophosphatidylethanolamine 18:0 and a 2-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine. It derives from an octadecanoic acid. It is a tautomer of a 2-octadecanoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine zwitterion.

The molecule is a acyl-sn-glycerol in which the acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are specified as oleoyl while that at position 3 is specifed as linoleoyl. It has a role as a mouse metabolite. It is a linoleoyl containing 1,2,3-triacyl-sn-glycerol. It derives from a linoleic acid and an oleic acid.

The molecule is a phosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of phosphonato-2-dehydro-3-deoxy-D-galactate; major species at pH 7.3. It is a conjugate base of a phosphonato-2-dehydro-3-deoxy-D-galactate.
The molecule is an N(2)-acetylglutaminate that has L-configuration; major species at pH 7.3. It is a conjugate base of a N-acetyl-L-glutamine. It is an enantiomer of a N-acetyl-D-glutaminate.

The molecule is an L-alpha-amino acid zwitterion obtained by transfer of a proton from the carboxy to the amino group of L-lysine; major species at pH 7.3. It is a conjugate base of a L-lysinium(1+). It is a tautomer of a L-lysine.

The molecule is a glycolipid, an alpha-L-rhamnoside of 3-[(3-hydroxydecanoyl)oxy]decanoic acid. It has a role as a nonionic surfactant. It is a conjugate acid of a L-rhamnosyl-3-hydroxydecanoyl-3-hydroxydecanoate.

The molecule is an organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxylic acid and phosphate functions; major species at pH 7.3. It is a conjugate base of a nicotinic acid D-ribonucleotide.

The molecule is a member of the class of pyrazoles that is 1H-pyrazole in which the hydrogens at positions 3, 4, and 5 are replaced by N-(hydroxyacetyl)piperidin-4-yl, pyrimidin-4-yl and p-chlorophenyl groups, respectively. It is a member of pyrazoles, a member of pyrimidines, a member of monochlorobenzenes and a primary alcohol.

The molecule is a flavanone glycoside that is (2S)-flavanone substituted by hydroxy groups at positions 5, 7, 4' and 5' and a beta-D-glucopyranosyloxy group at position 3' respectively. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a flavanone glycoside, a tetrahydroxyflavanone, a monosaccharide derivative, a beta-D-glucoside and a member of 4'-hydroxyflavanones. It derives from a (2S)-flavanone.

The molecule is a diterpenoid obtained by hydroxylation of one of the terminal methyl groups of geranylgeraniol. It is a diterpenoid, a glycol and a polyprenol. It derives from an (E,E)-geranylgeraniol.
The molecule is the carboxymethoxy derivative of succinic acid. It derives from a succinic acid. It is a conjugate acid of a 2-(carboxylatomethoxy)succinate(3-).

The molecule is a tertiary sterol that is tertiary sterol substituted by a hydroxy group at position 2. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is a tertiary sterol and a tertiary sterol. It derives from a hydride of a tertiary sterol.

The molecule is a steroid glucosiduronic acid resulting from the formal condensation of the carboxy group of steroid glucosiduronic acid with the amino group of steroid glucosiduronic acid. It has a role as a human metabolite and a mouse metabolite. It derives from a steroid glucosiduronic acid.

The molecule is a monomethoxyflavone that is quercetin in which the hydroxy group at position 3' is replaced by a methoxy group. It has a role as an EC 1.14.18.1 (tyrosinase) inhibitor, an anticoagulant and a metabolite. It is a 7-hydroxyflavonol, a tetrahydroxyflavone and a monomethoxyflavone. It derives from a quercetin. It is a conjugate acid of an isorhamnetin(1-).

The molecule is a diterpene lactone isolated from the whole plant of Ajuga ciliata. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is an acetate ester, a butenolide, a diterpene lactone, an enoate ester and a spiro-epoxide.
The molecule is an imidazolium ion resulting from the protonation of the nitrogen at position 3 of imidazole. It is a conjugate acid of a imidazole.

The molecule is a 5-alkylaminopurine that is adenine where one of the hydrogens of the amino group is replaced by a hydroxymethyl group. It has a role as a human metabolite. It is a 5-alkylaminopurine, a nucleobase analogue and a hemiaminal. It derives from an adenine.
The molecule is an organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate functions. It is a conjugate base of an organophosphate(4-).

The molecule is the member of the class of flexirubins obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of 17-(4-hydroxy-3-methylphenyl)heptadeca-2,4,6,8,10,12,14,16-octaenoic acid with one of the phenolic hydroxy groups of 2-dodecyl-5-methyl resorcinol.
The molecule is an icosanoic acid anion that is the conjugate base of (8Z,10E,14Z)-icosanoic acid. It has a role as a human xenobiotic metabolite. It derives from an all-cis-icosanoic acid.

The molecule is a secondary amino compound that is tyramine in which the hydrogen of the phenolic hydroxy group has been replaced by a methyl group. It has a role as a metabolite. It derives from a 4-methoxyphenylethylamine, a N-methyltyramine and a tyramine.

The molecule is an ammonium ion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is an ammonium ion and a member of ammonium ion. It derives from a (S)-corytuberine.
The molecule is an O-phosphoamino acid in which the amino acid specified is homoserine. It has a role as a human metabolite. It is an O-phosphoamino acid and an O-phosphoamino acid.

The molecule is a tetracenomycin that is tetracenomycin that is tetracenomycin bearing four hydroxy substituents at positions 3, 8, 10 and 12. It is a member of tetracenequinones, a member of hydroxy monocarboxylic acid and a member of phenols. It is a conjugate acid of a tetracenomycin D3(1-).
The molecule is a nitrosamine that is N-ethylethanamine substituted by a nitroso group at the N-atom. It has a role as a mutagen, a hepatotoxic agent and a carcinogenic agent.
The molecule is an omega-amino fatty acid that is the conjugate base of 5-aminopentanoate. It is a conjugate base of a 5-aminopentanoate. It is a conjugate base of a 5-aminopentanoate.

The molecule is a branched hexasaccharide derivative consisting of a linear tetrasaccharide unit of beta-L-rhamnose, beta-D-glucose, and two alpha-L-rhamnose residues, linked sequentially (1->4), (1->3) and (1->3), to the non-reducing-end alpha-L-rhamnose residue is also linked (1->2) an alpha-D-glucuronosyl-(1->6)-alpha-D-glucosyl disaccharide branch, the whole linked glycosidically to a 5-aminopentyl group.

The molecule is an unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of (9Z,13Z,14Z)-icosatrienoic acid. It is a long-chain fatty acyl-CoA and an unsaturated fatty acyl-CoA. It derives from a (9Z,13Z,14Z)-icosatrienoyl-CoA(4-). It is a conjugate acid of a (9Z,13Z,14Z)-icosatrienoyl-CoA(4-).
The molecule is a monocarboxylic acid anion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group of tetrapyrrole. It has a role as a metabolite. It is a conjugate base of a tetrapyrrole.

The molecule is a 2-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine in which the acyl group is specified as linoleoyl. It has a role as a human metabolite. It derives from a linoleic acid. It is a tautomer of a 2-linoleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine zwitterion.

The molecule is an amino disaccharide composed of N-acetylneuraminic acid and N-acetyl-alpha-D-galactosamine residues linked (2->6). It has a role as an epitope. It is an amino disaccharide and a galactosamine oligosaccharide.

The molecule is a leukotriene that is (5S,7E,9E,11Z)-5-hydroxyicosa-7,9,11-trienoic acid in which a glutathionyl group is attached at position 6 via a sulfide linkage. It has a role as a mouse metabolite and a rat metabolite. It is a leukotriene, a glutathione derivative and an organic sulfide. It is a conjugate acid of a leukotriene C3(2-).

The molecule is a nitrosamine that is N-nitrosodiethylamine in which one of the ethyl froups has been replaced by a 2-hydroxyethyl group. It has a role as a carcinogenic agent. It is a nitrosamine and a primary alcohol. It derives from a N-nitrosodiethylamine.

The molecule is an organophosphate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate groups of D-sorbose 1-phosphate. It is a conjugate base of a D-sorbose 1-phosphate. It is an enantiomer of a D-sorbose 1-phosphate.
The molecule is an anthracycline cation that is the conjugate acid of doxorubicin, arising from protonation of the amino group; major species at pH 7.3. It is a conjugate acid of a doxorubicin.
The molecule is a ceramide that is the N-hexacosanoyl derivative of C20 phytosphingosine. It is a C20 phytoceramide and a N-(very-long-chain fatty acyl)-sphingoid base.

The molecule is a sulfur-containing amino acid consisting of 2-aminodecanoic acid having a methylthio substituent at the 10-position. It is a non-proteinogenic alpha-amino acid and a methyl sulfide. It is a tautomer of a hexahomomethionine zwitterion.

The molecule is a 3-oxo-Delta(4)-steroid that is testosterone carrying an additional oxo substituent at position 11. It has a role as an androgen, a marine xenobiotic metabolite and a human metabolite. It is a 3-oxo-Delta(4)-steroid, an 11-oxo steroid, an androstanoid and a 17beta-hydroxy steroid. It derives from a testosterone. It derives from a hydride of an androstane.

The molecule is a nucleoside 3'-phosphate(2-) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate OH groups of uridine 3'-monophosphate (UMP) It is the predominant species at physiological pH. It is a conjugate base of a 3'-UMP.

The molecule is a sulfur-containing amino acid consisting of glycine core with a 2-mercaptoethyl side-chain. It has a role as a fundamental metabolite. It is a sulfur-containing amino acid, a member of homocysteines and a non-proteinogenic alpha-amino acid. It is a conjugate acid of a homocysteinate. It is a tautomer of a homocysteine zwitterion.

The molecule is an organochlorine compound that is chloramphenicol phosphonate hapten which acts as a transition state analogue for the hydrolysis of chloramphenicol esters mediated by the catalytic antibody 7C8. It has a role as a hapten. It is an organochlorine compound, a C-nitro compound and a trifluoroacetamide.

The molecule is a member of the class of acetamides that is acetamide in which one of the hydrogens attached to the nitrogen is replaced by a 9H-fluoren-4-yl group. It has a role as a mitogen. It is a member of acetamides and a member of fluorenes.

The molecule is a branched hexasaccharide consisting of alpha-D-Man at the reducing end having alpha-D-Man at the reducing end having alpha-D-Man-(1->2)-alpha-D-Man and alpha-D-Man groups attached at the 3- and 6-positions respectively.

The molecule is an organic sodium salt that is the tetrasodium salt of 3-hydroxy-4-[(4-sulfophenyl)diazenyl]phenyldiazenyl)naphthalene-2,7-disulfonic acid. It has a role as a histological dye and a fluorochrome. It is an organic sodium salt and an organosulfonate salt. It contains a Ponceau S(4-).
The molecule is an oxo dicarboxylic acid anion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group of oxomalonate; major species at pH 7.3. It is a conjugate base of an oxomalonate.

The molecule is a tetrahydroxyindolizidine alkaloid that consists of octahydroindolizine having four hydroxy substituents located at positions 1, 6, 7 and 8 (the 1S,6S,7R,8aR-diastereomer). It has a role as a metabolite, an anti-HIV-1 agent, an anti-inflammatory agent and an EC 3.2.1.* (glycosidase) inhibitor.
The molecule is a disaccharide consisting of beta-D-galactopyranose having a D-galactopyranosyl residue attached at the 6-position via an alpha-linkage. It derives from a beta-D-galactopyranose.
The molecule is an organosulfate oxoanion formed by proton loss from the sulfate group of N-acetyl-6-O-sulfo-D-glucosamine. It is a conjugate base of a N-acetyl-6-O-sulfo-D-glucosamine.

The molecule is an organic heterotetracyclic compound that is (2R,3S,4aR,8R,10S,13aS)-3,4,8-trihydroxy-2-(hydroxymethyl)-10-(4-methoxyphenyl)-12-methyl-3,4,4a,9,10,13a-hexahydro-2H,6H,8H-pyrano[3',2':2,3][1,4]dioxepino[6,5-g]chromen-7-ol substituted by a beta-D-glucosyl group. It has a role as a metabolite. It is an organic heterotetracyclic compound, a polycyclic ether, a monosaccharide derivative and a monosaccharide derivative.
The molecule is a sulfonate salt that is sulfonate in which the ratio of cobalt to sulfonate is 1:1. It contains a sulfonate(2+).
The molecule is a N-acylsphinganine-1-phosphocholine in which the ceramide N-acyl group is specified as nonadecanoyl. It has a role as a mouse metabolite. It derives from a nonadecanoic acid.

The molecule is a 1-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine in which the acyl group is specified as pentadecanoyl. It has a role as a rat metabolite and a human xenobiotic metabolite. It is a lysophosphatidylcholine 15:0 and a 1-O-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine. It derives from a pentadecanoic acid.

The molecule is an oxo monocarboxylic acid that is 3,8,8-trichloroocta-2,4,7-trienoic acid substituted by a 4-chlorophenyl group at position 7, a hydroxy group at position 2 and an oxo group at position 6. It is a member of monochlorobenzenes, an oxo monocarboxylic acid and an enol. It is a conjugate acid of a 6-oxo-2-hydroxy-7-(4'-chlorophenyl)-3,8,8-trienoate.

The molecule is a hydrochloride that is the monohydrate of the dihydrochloride salt of cefepime. It has a role as an antibacterial drug. It is a hydrochloride, a hydrate and a cephalosporin. It contains a cefepime(1+).

The molecule is a prostaglandin carboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of 6-oxoprostaglandin E1, obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group; major species at pH 7.3. It is a conjugate base of a 6-oxoprostaglandin E1.

The molecule is a member of the class of 4-pyridones that is nigerone B in which the nitrogen of the carboxamide has been acylated by a (3S)-3-carboxybutanoyl group. It has a role as an Aspergillus metabolite. It is a dicarboximide, a monocarboxylic acid, a member of 4-pyridones and a biaryl. It derives from a nygerone B.
The molecule is a glucotetrose consisting of beta-D-glucose with a further alpha-D-glucose unit linked to O-6 of the glucose residue at the non-reducing end. It derives from an alpha-D-glucose.
The molecule is a sodium salt obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group. It has a role as a human metabolite. It contains a sodium salt.
The molecule is a 2-oxoacyl-CoA having its S-acyl component derived from 2-oxocyclohexane-1-carboxylic acid. It derives from a cyclohexane-1-carbonyl-CoA and a 2-oxocyclohexanecarboxylic acid.

The molecule is a steroidal acyl-CoA that results from the formal condensation of the thiol group of coenzyme A with the carboxy group of 3-hydroxy-9-oxo-9,10-seco-23,24-bisnorchola-1,3,5(10)-trien-22-oic acid. It derives from a 3-hydroxy-9-oxo-9,10-seco-23,24-bisnorchola-1,3,5(10)-trien-22-oic acid. It is a conjugate acid of a 3-hydroxy-9-oxo-9,10-seco-23,24-bisnorchola-1,3,5(10)-trien-22-oyl-CoA(4-).

The molecule is a methyl ester obtained by formal condensation of the carboxy group of hexadecanoic acid with the methyl group of hexadecanoic acid. It has a role as a metabolite. It is a methyl ester and a methyl ester. It derives from an hexadecanoic acid.

The molecule is an L-cysteine thioether that is L-cysteine in which the hydrogen of the thiol group has been replaced by a carboxymethyl group. It has a role as a mucolytic. It is an L-cysteine thioether and a non-proteinogenic L-alpha-amino acid. It is a conjugate acid of a S-carboxylatomethyl-L-cysteine(1-).

The molecule is an acyl-sn-glycerol in which the acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are specified as oleoyl while that at position 3 is specifed as linoleoyl. It has a role as a mouse metabolite. It is a triacyl-sn-glycerol and a linoleoyl containing 1,2,3-triacyl-sn-glycerol. It derives from an oleic acid and an oleic acid.

The molecule is a hydrochloride salt resulting from the reaction of equimolar amounts of gevotroline and hydrogen chloride. It has a role as an antipsychotic agent and a dopamine receptor D2 antagonist. It contains a gevotroline(1+).

The molecule is a cholestanoid that consists of cholestanoid bearing an oxo substituent at position 7. It has a role as a neuroprotective agent. It is a cholestanoid, a 7-oxo steroid and a 3beta-hydroxy-Delta(5)-steroid. It derives from a cholestanoid.
The molecule is a 3beta-sterol having the structure of desmosterol with an extra double bond at C-7--C-8. It has a role as a human metabolite and a mouse metabolite. It derives from a desmosterol.

The molecule is a linear pentasaccharide consisting of a beta-D-galactose residue, three L-glycero-alpha-D-manno-heptose residues and (at the reducing end) a 3-deoxy-alpha-D-manno-oct-2-ulopyranosonic acid (Kdo) residue linked sequentially (1->2), (1->2), (1->3) and (1->5); the structure is that of the pentasaccharide epitope from Haemophilus influenzae MAHI 4.

The molecule is an isoquinoline alkaloid that is 3,4,4a,5,6,10b-hexahydro-5,10b-ethanophenanthridin-9-ol bearing three additional methoxy substituents at positions 3, 7 and 8. It has a role as a plant metabolite. It is an isoquinoline alkaloid, an organic heterotetracyclic compound, an aromatic ether and a member of phenols.

The molecule is a steroid sulfate oxoanion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxylic acid and sulfate functions of glycochenodeoxycholic acid 7-sulfate. It is a steroid sulfate oxoanion and a glycochenodeoxycholic acid sulfate anion. It is a conjugate base of a glycochenodeoxycholic acid 7-sulfate.
The molecule is an acyl-CoA(4-) obtained by deprotonation of the phosphate and diphosphate OH groups of coenzyme A; major species at pH 7.3. It is a conjugate base of a coenzyme A.

The molecule is a cysteine derivative consisting of L-cysteine carrying an S-hydroxy-substituent. It is a L-cysteine derivative and a non-proteinogenic L-alpha-amino acid. It is a tautomer of a S-oxy-L-cysteine.
The molecule is a bile acid monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of deoxycholic acid. It has a role as a human metabolite. It derives from a deoxycholic acid.
The molecule is a monocarboxylic acid anion obtained by deprotonation of the carboxy group of tetrapyrrole; major species at pH 7.3. It is a conjugate base of a tetrapyrrole.
The molecule is an oligopeptide composed of N(6)-[lipoyl]-Lys, N(6)-[lipoyl]-Lys, Ala, Thr, Ile, Gly, Phe, Glu, Val, Gln, Glu and Glu residues joined in sequence.
The molecule is a sulfonate salt that is sulfonate in which the hydrogen is replaced by a hydrogen. It has a role as a chelator and an anticoagulant. It contains a sulfonate salt.

The molecule is a branched pentasaccharide derivative consisting of an alpha-D-galactosyl-(1->3)-beta-D-galactosyl-(1->4)-N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosamine trisaccharide backbone onto which are linked two alpha-alpha-L-fucosyl residues, one (1->2) onto the central galactose residue and the other (1->3) onto the N-acetylglucosamine residue at the reducing end. It is an amino pentasaccharide and a glucosamine oligosaccharide.

The molecule is an aminoglycoside antibiotic that is (1S,3S)-3-ethyl-3,5,12-trihydroxy-10-methoxy-6,11-dioxo-1,2,3,4,6,11-hexahydrotetracene having a 3-amino-2,3,6-trideoxy-alpha-L-lyxo-hexopyranosyl residue attached at position 1 via a glycosidic linkage. It is an aminoglycoside antibiotic, an anthracycline, a deoxy hexoside, a monosaccharide derivative and a member of p-quinones. It derives from a hydride of a tetracene.

The molecule is a 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycerol in which the acyl groups at positions 1 and 2 are specified as alpha-linolenoyl and (5Z,8Z,11Z)-icosatrienoyl respectively.
